pages.text: You are in an emergency room assessing a patient with acute chest pain.

options.option: listen to the patient's heart with the stethoscope
options.extra: auscultate heart, use stethoscope on chest, check heart sounds

options.option: read the vital signs on the monitor
options.extra: check monitor, look at vitals, read heart rate and blood pressure

options.option: order an EKG for the patient
options.extra: get ekg, run electrocardiogram, perform ekg test

options.option: attach the IV line to the patient
options.extra: connect iv, start iv fluids, hook up iv

options.option: what are the patient's symptoms and history?
options.extra: tell me the history, what symptoms does the patient have, patient background

options.option: this patient is having a myocardial infarction
options.extra: heart attack diagnosis, acute mi, stemi diagnosis
